# Isoplane documentation

> Customer documentation for building and running .NET applications in Isoplane's WebAssembly sandbox, published at https://isoplane.dev/docs/.

Every page is available as Markdown. Append `.md` to a page's address (https://isoplane.dev/docs/quickstart is https://isoplane.dev/docs/quickstart.md; a directory address such as https://isoplane.dev/docs/ is https://isoplane.dev/docs/index.md), or request the page with an `Accept: text/markdown` header. Each Markdown page begins with YAML front matter giving its title, its description when it has one, and its canonical address.

The documentation is published once per release line. The newest line is at https://isoplane.dev/docs/ and each older line at https://isoplane.dev/docs/<line>/, where the line is named for the release that began it, such as 0.1. Documentation for unreleased changes is not published.

## Pages

- [Sitemap](https://isoplane.dev/docs/sitemap.xml): every published page, in every release line
